claims.statement: The European Health Data Space framework covers genetic, genomic and other health data for specified secondary-use purposes subject to safeguards and permits.
The IVDR regulates in-vitro diagnostic devices and specifically addresses genetic testing and information about its implications.

contrary_evidence: EHDS access is purpose-limited and permit-based; it does not create an unrestricted proprietary data asset or commercial exclusivity.

economics.acquisition_route: Unvalidated: one accredited Polish lab integration, then expand through lab networks and research collaborations rather than direct-to-consumer sales.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated scenario, not a forecast: process 5,000 tests by year 2, reach 6 million PLN ARR by year 5, build 4 million PLN founder equity and cash by year 7, and 5 million PLN founder net worth in years 8-11.
economics.founder_time: Unvalidated operating estimate: 2-4 hours per day only if a clinical lead and quality consultant own regulated operations.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated: 55%-80% gross margin after clinical review, quality management, secure compute and data-governance costs.
economics.payback: Unvalidated: 24-42 months because regulatory and clinical validation precede scale.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated commercial figures, including capital_required_pln: 120-350 PLN per interpreted test and 100,000-400,000 PLN annual benchmark licence.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Unvalidated: lab orders recur and the curation corpus updates; contract renewal is not evidenced.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Each lawfully consented follow-up and adjudicated interpretation deepens population-specific evidence and reduces review effort
fingerprint.customer: Central-European diagnostic laboratories and clinical researchers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Embedded in existing lab orders and result-delivery workflows
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: White-label interpretation with clinician oversight plus permitted derived-evidence licensing
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: A lab pays per clinician-ready interpretation; approved researchers or product developers pay for governed benchmark access
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A lab generates a genetic result whose local-population interpretation and follow-up evidence are weak

founder_fit: Strong match to genetics, neuroscience and data science.
Medical-student household context helps frame clinical questions but does not substitute for qualified governance.
risks: Regulatory and quality-system cost exceeds bootstrap capital.
A lab retains the channel and derived-data rights.

structure.commercial_archetype: Lab-embedded interpretation and governed evidence licensing
structure.control_point: Exclusive lab distribution contracts and lawful rights to derived, de-identified curation and outcome benchmarks with participant protections
structure.critical_dependency: IVDR classification and quality system, clinical governance, valid GDPR and EHDS pathways, and sufficiently representative data

thesis: Partner with accredited diagnostic labs to deliver a white-label, clinician-reviewed interpretation layer for legally obtained genetic tests while building a consented Central-European variant, ancestry and follow-up evidence corpus. Labs provide structural distribution; the controlled asset is a governed derived benchmark and curation history, never ownership of patients' data rights.
title: Central-European Variant Evidence Network
uncertainties: Regulatory classification of the exact service
Consent and secondary-use rights obtainable from lab partners
